title: SG-7.1 · Add the worker Go module with config, logger, file lock and JSON store
summary: Create the missing worker Go module with config loader, structured logger, file lock and JSON execution store
description: Context: no worker module exists in the workspace (the repo holds only backend/, game/ and context.md). SG-7 needs a foundation for the execution runner. Desired behavior: a separate Go module at backend/worker with a YAML config loader, a JSON structured logger, an exclusive file lock and a JSON execution store. Expected result: each piece builds and has unit-testable behavior. Why: the runner can then be built on top of these primitives.
acceptance_criteria: Given a YAML file, when worker config LoadFS runs, then defaults are filled and STORYFORGE_WORKER_* env values override YAML values
Given a logger built with a level, when a record is logged, then one JSON line is written containing msg and level
Given a held lock file, when a second Acquire runs on the same path, then it fails with ErrLocked until Release is called
Given an execution, when Save then Get run on the store, then the same record is returned and unsafe ids are rejected

out_of_scope: runner, providers, poller and git operations
preserve: existing backend module and its tests

technical_constraints: Go, YAML via gopkg.in/yaml.v3, stdlib log/slog
No database; state is JSON files on the local filesystem
definition_of_done: All four packages build with go build ./... inside backend/worker
